channel.title: The Grant Desk - Africa, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Africa, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: 2 new grants - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Delfina Foundation: Open Call for Curators Based in Central and West Africa (London residency)
    https://www.delfinafoundation.com/open-calls/current/open-call-for-curators-based-in-central-and-west-africa/
    Delfina Foundation · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · Fully supported: a return economy-class flight, airport transfers in the UK, reimbursement of visa fees if required, a living allowance of GBP 40 per day, a materials and research allowance of GBP 70 per week, a travel pass for London's public transport network, and a single bedroom with a desk at Delfina Foundation, a house hosting up to eight residents with shared bathrooms, laundry rooms, kitchen, library and dining room. Supported by Delfina Foundation's Network of Patrons for Africa. No application fee.
  • Connect and Create: Circulation of Performing Arts and Music (Africa-Europe) - 2nd Call
    https://ifprog.emundus.fr/en/campagne-info?view=programme&cid=353
    Goethe-Institut and Expertise France, in collaboration with Institut francais (Africa-Europe Partnerships for Culture consortium) · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · EUR 15,000 to EUR 39,500 per project, covering travel, visas, insurance, accommodation, per diems, local transport and shipping of scenographic and technical elements. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 3 new grants - week of 08 Jun 2026
item.description:
• EUNIC: Spaces of Culture 2026 (Call for Proposals)
    https://eunic.eu/news/spaces-of-culture-2026
    EUNIC (European Union National Institutes for Culture) · deadline Closed 21 Jun 2026 · Up to EUR 50,000 per project; minimum 5 percent co-funding required from partners. Projects implemented 1 September 2026 to 31 August 2027.
  • ARUA: Early-Career Research Fellowships 2026 (Option 2)
    https://arua.org/early-career-research-fellowships/
    African Research Universities Alliance (ARUA), with the Mastercard Foundation and Carnegie Corporation of New York · deadline Closed 15 Jul 2026 · Monthly stipend of USD 2,000, a modest accommodation payment, and travel support (return ticket to host institution). 6-month fellowship.
  • Cambridge-Africa: ALBORADA Research Fund 2026
    https://www.cambridge-africa.cam.ac.uk/initiatives/2026-call-for-applications
    Cambridge-Africa Programme, University of Cambridge (supported by The ALBORADA Trust) · deadline Closed 03 Sep 2026 · Competitive grants of GBP 1,000 to 25,000. Covers research costs such as reagents, fieldwork, equipment and research-training activities in Africa (e.g. setting up courses/workshops). No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).
